sources.title: primitive-ai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The 180B Flash-Next on one GPU. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is 360 GB in BF16 and needs two data-center GPUs in FP8. This build serves it on one 96 GB Blackwell: 88.8 GiB of VRAM, the 51B n-gram table in host RAM, and no patched runtime.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a new open-weight, 125B parameter MoE multimodal model from Qwen. Built on the new Qwen4 architecture, it supports a 262K context window and advanced reasoning. sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a multimodal, ultra-sparse Mixture-of-Experts model. It has 125B parameters, including an additional 51B N-gram embedding table, while activating 6B parameters per token. The architecture combines four main ideas: GDN + QSA: three of every four layers use Gated DeltaNet to compress history; the fourth uses Qwen Sparse Attention for precise long-range retrieval ...
